posts.alt: Bonita backyard outdoor kitchen under a StruXure louvered pergola with a stainless Bull grill, bar seating and pavers at golden hour

posts.caption:

Bar seating faces the grill, the pergola louvers tilt the sun off the cooktop, and the whole thing is built to shrug off years of San Diego summers.

The selections:
• StruXure louvered pergola
• Bull built-in grill
• Danver stainless cabinetry
• Techo-Bloc Aberdeen pavers
• string lights & olive trees

posts.alt: Coastal San Diego backyard with a linear travertine fire feature, low lounge seating and an ocean view at golden hour

posts.alt: Wide paver driveway with formal landscaping in front of a Mediterranean estate in San Diego at golden hour
posts.hook: A driveway can be architecture too.
posts.caption:
Most driveways are an afterthought poured in a day. This one was designed.

Wide-format pavers set in a clean field, a soldier-course border to frame it, symmetrical planting to walk the eye to the door. It reads as part of the house, because it is.

The selections:
• Belgard wide-format pavers
• soldier-course banding
• boxwood, agave & olive trees
• landscape lighting
• drought-tolerant beds
